comparison.objective: Separate finishing media from workpieces, versus loading hinged surgical forceps into a sterilizer basket.
comparison.physical_skill: Screen agitation and granular-flow control versus opening, orienting and arranging hinged instruments for sterilization.
comparison.success_condition: Media recovered with all washers retained versus forceps correctly open, contained and arranged in the basket.
comparison.reason: Basket loading and instrument articulation do not test size-selective passage through a screen.
